findings.evidence: The privacy policy mentions collecting 'contact information' but does not specify the exact type of contact information collected or the purposes for which it is used.
The privacy policy mentions collecting 'location' but does not specify the exact type of location data collected or the purposes for which it is shared.
The privacy policy mentions collecting 'financial' data but does not specify the exact type of financial data collected or the purposes for which it is used.
The privacy policy mentions collecting 'cookies and tracking elements' but does not specify the exact type of cookies and tracking elements collected or the purposes for which they are shared.
